plan.title: Invite all mapped vendors to an eRFX RFQ

steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Configure the project with RFQ only, removing the default Auction stage.
Work on the RFQ stage before selecting its template and adding items.
Add one CYLINDER-matching product with the requested quantity; exact variant selection is not expressible.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be scheduled and published.
Use the product-based Invite Vendor action to add every vendor mapped to the product.
Publish the RFQ project after inviting the mapped vendors.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants list to inspect the invited audience.
Confirm that the mapped-vendor invitation resulted in participants on the RFQ stage; the exact expected roster is not supplied.
